chinese: 阳光正从云层中透出来！
english: The sun is shining through the clouds!

chinese: 真高兴我们来到了光明顶。
english: I’m so glad we’re here at Bright Peak.

chinese: 今天我和家人一起游览黄山。
english: Today I’m visiting Mount Huangshan with my family.

chinese: 我并不是很享受这次体验。
english: I’m not really enjoying the experience.

chinese: 一切都看起来灰蒙蒙的，而且因为大雾，
english: Everything looks grey, and you can’t see much

chinese: 看不清楚太多东西。地面非常湿滑，
english: because of the heavy fog. The ground is very wet,
so we have to climb slowly.
